usage: icebath computer-use [-h] {install,status,doctor,permissions,screen} ...

Install or check the cua-driver binary used by the `computer_use` toolset. Supported on macOS,
Windows, and Linux. Use `icebath computer-use install` to prepare the pinned cua-driver package
and host integration. This is equivalent to the post-setup hook that `icebath tools` runs when you
first enable the Computer Use toolset, and is a stable target for re-running the install if it
didn't fire (e.g. when toggling the toolset on a returning-user setup). Use `icebath computer-use
doctor` to run cua-driver's `health_report` MCP tool and surface its check matrix (TCC, bundle
identity, version, platform support, ...) in human-readable form.

positional arguments:
  {install,status,doctor,permissions,screen}
    install             Install or repair the cua-driver binary (macOS/Windows/Linux)
    status              Check the selected cua-driver and its runtime contract
    doctor              Run cua-driver `health_report` and surface the check matrix
    permissions         Check or grant macOS Accessibility + Screen Recording (macOS)
    screen              Bot Desktop: the headless screen this profile's computer_use drives
                        (Linux)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
